visualCharacteristics.purpose: keyword search and dropdown filters over the forms library, with a list of forms

contentPattern.structure: field rows: `Search for keyword or form number | search`, `Category | select | options`, `Search | submit`, `Clear all | reset`. Content rows: the forms list as a list of links or a table (one form per item or row)

reuseGuidance: Use for a searchable list of documents authored on the page. Filtering runs client-side over the authored items; it does not query an index.
decisions: The source queries a server-side forms library; the block filters the authored list client-side instead.
Bulk email and server pagination are not reproduced; select values that match no item (e.g. 10 per page) are ignored.
